```js
await (async(page)=>{const results=[];for(const[view,width,height]of[['desktop',1440,1000],['mobile',390,844]]){const p=await page.context().newPage();p.setDefaultTimeout(5000);await p.setViewportSize({width,height});await p.goto('http://127.0.0.1:5173/backoffice?mock=1');await p.locator('main time').waitFor();await p.waitForTimeout(400);const before=await p.locator('main time').getAttribute('datetime');await p.context().setOffline(true);await p.getByRole('button',{name:'다시 확인',exact:true}).click();await p.waitForTimeout(1200);const text=await p.locator('body').innerText();const failedUrl=p.url();if(!text.includes('인터넷에 연결되지 않았어요')||failedUrl.includes('chrome-error'))throw new Error('offline guard failed '+failedUrl);if(await p.locator('main time').getAttribute('datetime')!==before)throw new Error('offline status mutated');await p.screenshot({path:'/home/qed/workspace/MonkeyScrimManager2/artifacts/ui-review/after/backoffice-offline-'+view+'.png',fullPage:true});await p.context().setOffline(false);const retry=p.getByRole('button',{name:'다시 확인',exact:true});if(await retry.count())await retry.click();else{const commonRetry=p.getByRole('button',{name:'다시 시도',exact:true});if(await commonRetry.count()){const nav=p.waitForEvent('domcontentloaded');await commonRetry.click();await nav;}else await p.goto('http://127.0.0.1:5173/backoffice?mock=1');}await p.locator('main time').waitFor();await p.waitForTimeout(400);if(await p.locator('main [role=alert]').count())throw new Error('recovery error remains');results.push({view,before,failureText:text,failedUrl,recoveredText:await p.locator('main').innerText(),after:await p.locator('main time').getAttribute('datetime')});await p.close();}return results;})(page);
```
